name: Jumbo Raspberry Dolly
ingredients:
JUMBO RASPBERRY DOLLY-Ice Cream. Ingredients: Outer Layer - Raspberry Flavored Syrup (60%): Added Water, Sugar, Liquid Glucose, Acidity gulator (INS 330), Stabilizers (INS 412, INS 407, INS 440), Artificial (Raspberry) Flavoring Substances, Synthetic Food Colours (INS 122). 
Inner Layer-Ice Cream (40%): Added Water, Milk Solids, Sugar, Emulsifiers (INS 471, INS 433) and Stabilizers (INS 466, INS 412, INS 407a, INS 415, INS 410). Food Allergen: Contains Milk. May Contain Wheat, Nut and Soy.
